products.name: Filter Leaf Screens & Replacement Mesh
products.headline: Replacement Leaf Screens & Mesh for Pressure Leaf Filters
products.summary: Stainless steel leaf screens and replacement mesh for vertical and horizontal pressure leaf filters, made to your sample or drawing.
products.content_html:
Filter Leaf Screens & Replacement Mesh

The leaf screens are the part of a pressure leaf filter that actually does the filtering, and the part that gets damaged first. A torn weld, a dented frame, or mesh blinded by filter aid shows up as cloudy filtrate or a cake that will not release. We supply replacement leaf screens and mesh for vertical and horizontal pressure leaf filters, including CFP-type vertical filters, in edible oil, chemical, resin, sugar, beverage and other liquid filtration.

What we supply

  • Complete replacement leaves: mesh stretched on a stainless frame with the outlet nipple or neck welded in, ready to hang on the manifold.
  • Replacement mesh: multi-layer stainless steel wire mesh, if you prefer to re-skin your own frames.
  • Leaf sets: a full set for one vessel, matched by size and count so the leaves fit the manifold spacing.

How the leaves are built

Each leaf uses a layered stainless steel wire mesh: a fine filtering layer on the outside, backed by coarser support and drainage layers so the leaf stays flat under pressure and the filtrate can flow to the outlet. Because the cake is dislodged by gas blow and vibration rather than scraped off, a leaf has to stay flat and keep its mesh opening through many cycles.

Signs your leaves need replacing

  • Filtrate turns cloudy or carries filter aid or solids after a clean start-up
  • Differential pressure climbs faster than it used to, or does not drop after a normal cake discharge
  • Cake sticks to the leaves after blow-down and vibration
  • Visible tears, bent frames, or broken welds when the vessel is opened

Ordering

To quote accurately we need the filter make and model, the leaf dimensions (height, width, thickness), the outlet and connection type, the number of leaves per vessel, and the mesh opening in micron. A worn leaf or a drawing is the quickest reference. We can match the original or supply a different mesh grade if your process has changed.

products.name: Scraping Self-Cleaning Filter (AF Series)
products.headline: AF Series Mechanical Scraping Self-Cleaning Liquid Filter
products.summary: Continuous 24/7 online scraping self-cleaning filter designed for high-viscosity, sticky, or hazardous fluids without filter consumables, downtime, or manual cleaning.
products.content_html:
AF Series Mechanical Scraping Self-Cleaning Filter

The AF Scraper-type Self-cleaning Filter is engineered to remove impurities and suspended solids on the surface of precision filter screens via highly efficient mechanical scraping. Utilizing intelligent differential pressure (ΔP) and cycle-time automation, the AF filter cleans the screen automatically and expels concentrated impurities without human intervention or consumable filter bags and cartridges.

Eliminating the Pain Points of Traditional Filtration

Traditional bag, basket, and vibrating-screen filters suffer from low pollutant holding capacity, rapid blinding, and the constant need for manual dismantling, cleaning, and disposable media purchases. In high-viscosity or hazardous services, manual cleanout exposes workers to volatile vapors, skin hazards, and elevated temperatures. The AF Series delivers consecutive online filtration, zero consumable disposal costs, and reliable protection for downstream pumps, valves, and heat exchangers.

4 Specialized Subseries for Diverse Fluid Rheologies

  • AFE Series (External Motor-Driven Scraper): Features an external scraping blade driven by an electric gearmotor across the outer surface of the filter screen. Specially designed for high-viscosity resins, polymers, adhesives, and thick fluids.
  • AFC Series (Pneumatic Inner Scraper): Utilizes a pneumatic air-cylinder to drive vertical scraping movements along the inner surface of the filter screen. Ideal for medium-to-high viscosity fluids, explosive environments (ATEX), and inflammable volatile solvents.
  • AFM Series (Internal Motor-Driven Scraper): Employs an electric gearmotor to rotate heavy-duty scraping blades along the inner screen surface. Designed for medium and high-viscosity materials and general suspended solid filtration.
  • AFB Series (Internal Motor-Driven Rotating Brush): Features high-density stainless steel or nylon scraping brushes rotated by motor along the inner screen surface. Engineered specifically for water, cooling liquids, low-viscosity fluids, and high-precision screening down to 1 micron.

Intelligent Self-Cleaning & Purge Operation

As impurities accumulate on the screen, differential pressure rises. When the preset ΔP threshold (or timer) is reached, the scraper drive activates, scraping cake and particles toward the bottom accumulation chamber. The automatic drain valve opens briefly, expelling waste fluid containing high-concentration impurities with negligible fluid loss, instantly restoring full screen throughput.

products.name: Automated Backwash Filter (AR Series)
products.headline: AR High-Efficiency Multi-Cartridge Automatic Backwash Water Filter
products.summary: High-flux automated backwash filter with integrated multi-element wedge screens and rotating recoil arm for continuous 24/7 water and low-viscosity fluid purification.
products.content_html:
AR Series Automated Backwash Filter

The AR High-efficiency Multi-Cartridge Self-cleaning Backwash Filter integrates multiple precision aperture-type wedge-wire screens within a compact single pressure vessel. When particulate matter blocks screen elements, a motorized rotating recoil device backwashes the filter screens sequentially one by one, while all other screens remain online filtering at full capacity.

Large Surface Area & Continuous High-Flux Filtration

Unlike standard backwash filters that suffer from rapid blinding and excessive backwash water loss, the AR Series features an ultra-large total filtration area that ensures low face velocity and accurate particulate interception. The entire series spans a precision range of 50 to 3,000 microns and flow rates up to 8,000 m³/h per vessel, making it the premier choice for circulating cooling water, raw water intake, and low-viscosity industrial fluids.

8 Standardized Subseries (AR300 through AR1000)

Available in eight standardized mechanical configurations (AR300, AR400, AR500, AR600, AR700, AR800, AR900, AR1000), the AR Series accommodates diverse pipeline diameters from DN100 up to DN800+. Each model features rigid stainless steel V-shaped slot wedge-wire screens that prevent clogging and ensure complete release of suspended solids during the reverse recoil flush.

Automated Sequential Recoil Operation

Differential pressure transmitters monitor pressure across the housing. When the preset ΔP setpoint (typically 0.05 MPa) is met, the gearmotor turns the backwash arm into alignment with the first filter screen, and the drain valve opens. The pressure differential between the vessel interior and the atmospheric drain forces clean filtrate in reverse through the screen, purging trapped solids into the drain header. The arm indexes to each screen in turn until all elements are thoroughly regenerated.

products.name: Sealed Candle Filter (CFC Series)
products.headline: CFC Series Hermetic Automatic Cake & Pre-Coating Candle Filter
products.summary: Hermetically sealed pressure candle filter for direct filtration, pre-coat filtration, slurry concentration, cake washing, and automated gas blowback cake discharge.
products.content_html:
CFC Series High-Efficiency Sealed Candle Filter

The CFC High-efficiency Seal Candle Filter is an enclosed pressure filtration system designed for precise solid-liquid separation, cake washing, and slurry thickening. Material is fed into the filter vessel via feed pump. Prior to normal filtration, fluid undergoes closed cycling until a uniform, porous filter cake forms on vertical candle elements, initiating crystal-clear filtration.

Zero-Emission Hermetic Cake Filtration

When the filter cake reaches the optimum operating thickness, remaining residual liquid is displaced from the vessel using pressurized gas or recovery pumps. Controlled gas blowback (compressed air, nitrogen, or steam) is applied through the core of the candle tubes, inflating the filter cloth sleeves and instantaneously dislodging the cake. The automated bottom slag-drip cone valve opens to discharge the cake as dry solids or concentrated slurry, returning the vessel to its pristine initial state for the next cycle.

Key Process Capabilities

  • Direct Clarifying Filtration: Intercepts fine particles down to 0.5 microns without filter aids.
  • Pre-Coat Filtration: Facilitates pre-coating with diatomaceous earth (DE), perlite, or activated carbon for colloidal and gelatinous impurities.
  • In-Situ Cake Washing & Drying: Thoroughly washes residual mother liquor from cake and dries cake with hot inert gas or steam.
  • Total Containment: Zero leakage of toxic, flammable, volatile, or odorous liquids, guaranteeing total operator safety.

products.name: Modular Integrated Filter (MIF Series)
products.headline: MIF Series Multi-Station Modular Backwash Filter System
products.summary: Modular integrated filtration skid combining 2 to 24 standard filter units for low-drop-out continuous online filtration with reverse-flow backwashing.
products.content_html:
MIF Series Module Integrated Filter

The MIF Module Integrated Filter is engineered around the principle of system integration, combining multiple standardized filter modules (2 to 24 units, MIF2 through MIF24) onto a unified header manifold skid. As process flowrate demands increase, filter stations can be seamlessly scaled up or down without altering core piping layout.

Continuous Low Drop-Out Modular Filtration

MIF operates automatically without manual intervention and is renowned for its ultra-low pressure drop-out. Each unit houses a high-performance V-shaped aperture stainless steel screen. During backwashing, the system leverages reverse flowage of clean filtrate generated by the other running filter units (internal backwash) or introduces external clean fluid to thoroughly flush the screen surface with minimal effluent volume.

High Pressure & Temperature Resilience

Engineered for demanding refinery and petrochemical loops, the MIF Series supports operating pressures up to 4.0 MPa (40 bar) and temperatures up to 250°C, providing robust continuous filtration for diesel, gasoline, naphtha, cooling water, and process loops.

ST Series Industrial Basket Filter & Strainer

The ST Basket Filter features heavy-duty stainless steel perforated and mesh filter baskets that intercept large particles and pipe debris. Baskets are easily removed, washed, and reused repeatedly, providing long service life with virtually zero consumable costs while protecting sensitive downstream pumps, flowmeters, and process equipment.

  • STS Series (Single-Basket Quick-Open): Versatile single-basket configuration with quick-open upper cover, applicable across wide industrial process duties.

products.name: Centrifugal Separator & Rotary Filter (CS & RS Series)
products.headline: CS Centrifugal Solid-Liquid Separator & RS Secondary Rotary Filter
products.summary: Maintenance-free hydrocyclone centrifugal sand separators and rotary secondary screen filters for removing high-density solids without filter media.
products.content_html:
CS Centrifugal Separator & RS Rotary Filter

The CS Series Solid Separator utilizes centrifugal vortex dynamics to separate precipitable solids and sand without internal moving components or consumable filter elements. The RS Series combines centrifugal pre-separation with a secondary cylindrical stainless steel screen to capture fine solids down to 25 µm with greater than 90% separation efficiency.

CS Hydrocyclone Operating Principle

Process fluid enters the tangential acceleration chamber at high velocity, generating an intense vortex. Heavy particles (> 40 µm at 98% efficiency down to 5 µm) are forced outward against the conical wall and spiral down into the bottom quiet collection chamber. Purified liquid spirals upward through the central vortex finder. The collection chamber purges accumulated solids automatically via an automated timed ball valve.

RS Dual-Stage Rotary Filtration

For applications where fine suspended particles must be caught alongside dense grit, the RS Rotary Filter adds a secondary stainless steel filter screen. High-density debris separates centrifugally, while remaining low-density solids are held on the screen without recurring consumables.

products.name: MS High-Intensity Magnetic Iron Remover
products.headline: MS Series 12,000 Gauss Super-Magnetic Liquid Iron Remover
products.summary: Ultra-high-intensity 12,000 Gauss NdFeB permanent magnetic separator for capturing microscopic ferromagnetic particles, rust, cobalt, and nickel from liquid streams.
products.content_html:
MS Strong Magnetic Iron Remover

The MS Iron Remover is engineered to eliminate microscopic ferromagnetic contaminants—such as pipeline rust, weld slag, wear particles, cobalt, and nickel—from liquid product streams. Optimized via 3D finite element magnetic circuit modeling, the MS device houses superpower NdFeB (Neodymium Iron Boron) permanent magnetic bars generating a peak surface field of 12,000 Gauss, the highest permanent magnetic intensity in the world.

Protecting High-Value Equipment & Product Purity

Sub-micron ferrous particles bypass standard mechanical screens and cause catastrophic wear to downstream homogenizers, progressive cavity pumps, mechanical seals, and nozzles, while spoiling high-purity paints, food, and pharmaceutical formulations. The MS Series traps iron particles tightly against the non-magnetic stainless steel tube sleeves. The quick-open clamp or swing-bolt lid allows rapid removal of the magnetic grid for wipe cleaning.

products.content_html:
Precision Filter Cartridges & Bags

As the core of CT Cartridge Filters and BT Bag Filters, filter cartridges and bags dictate final filtrate clarity and process uptime. Manufactured under strict ISO 9001 and cleanroom quality control, Shanghai JCI filter cartridges and bags utilize premium global base media engineered for high dirt-holding capacity, low initial pressure drop, and extended on-stream life.

Comprehensive Filter Cartridge Portfolio

  • Pleated Membrane Cartridges: High-surface area pleated PP, PES, PTFE, and PVDF membranes for sub-micron sterile and high-clarity filtration (0.05 µm to 50 µm).
  • Melt-Blown PP Cartridges: Thermally bonded virgin polypropylene with graded pore density for depth filtration.
  • Wire-Wound Cartridges: Precision CNC string-wound elements for high-temperature and high-solids fluid service.
  • Sintered Metal & Titanium Rods: Sintered porous SS316L and titanium elements built for extreme temperatures, high differential pressures, and aggressive solvents. Cleanable and backwashable for repeated reuse.
  • Large Flow Elements: 6-inch large diameter pleated elements handling high flux up to 80 m³/h per element.

Liquid Filter Bags & Sealing Rings

Available in polypropylene needle felt, polyester, and woven nylon monofilament mesh (NMO/NO) from 0.5 to 1,250 microns. Features heavy-duty stainless steel collar rings or molded polypropylene SDS collars with zero-bypass extension lips.
